{{Quote|We are on the verge of a civil war, Captain. And that boy is the Supreme Commander of Mon Cala's military. It's up to you to see that he remains ''safe'', and that he can ''handle'' the job.|[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Meena Tills/Legends|Meena Tills]], to Captain Ackbar|<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>}}
'''Mon Cala's military''' comprised the standing [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala's]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. It was led by the [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|King of Mon Cala]], who acted as the [[Supreme Commander (Mon Cala)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the military as part of [[Gender/Legends|his]] duties.

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|civil war]] broke out between the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], and [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala's]] military was forced to fight them off. Many of the [[Mon Calamari trooper/Legends|soldiers]] died after the battle, and the rest of the [[Army/Legends|army]] joined up with the Quarren and rebuilt the task force led by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]].
